meta.name: info-funnel
meta.description: 3-6 阶递减漏斗, 突出转化率 / 筛选比例 / 流量损耗。竖图适合 IG Story / 小红书

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作转化漏斗图，突出流量损耗与筛选比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在社交媒体上展示营销漏斗数据
copy.tagline_en: Create conversion funnel charts highlighting traffic loss and filter ratios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present marketing funnel data on social media

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供漏斗各阶段数据时，它会生成一张 9:16 竖版漏斗信息图，包含 3-6 个递减梯形，标注每阶人数、转化率和底部累计转化率，输出为单文件 HTML。
howto.when: 当你要求生成展示转化率、筛选比例或流量损耗的漏斗图时，例如营销、招聘、决策等场景，这个技能会输出竖版信息图。

say.text: 做一个 5 阶漏斗图，显示访客到注册的转化。
say.note: Claude 会按默认主题生成竖版 HTML。

say.text: 画一个招聘漏斗：投递、面试、录用、入职，每步人数和转化率。
say.note: 会生成四阶漏斗，并自动计算阶段转化率。

say.text: 生成一张 9:16 的漏斗图，突出每步流失，用橙色主题。

howto.what_en: When asked for a funnel, Claude outputs a single-file HTML, 9:16 vertical, with 3-6 descending trapezoids showing each stage's count, step conversion, and overall conversion at the bottom.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a funnel chart highlighting conversion, filtering, or drop-off, for example marketing, recruiting, or decision funnels; also fits IG Story / Xiaohongshu verticals.

say_en.text: Make a 5-step funnel showing visitors to sign-ups.
say_en.note: Claude renders a vertical HTML with the default theme.

say_en.text: Draw a hiring funnel with per-stage counts and conversion rates.
say_en.note: It creates a four-step funnel and calculates conversions.

say_en.text: Generate a 9:16 funnel emphasizing drop-offs, using an orange theme.
say_en.note: It will use the sunset-amber palette.
